Hanoi To Cao Bang Private Car is a top-quality transfer service offered by Vietlook Travel. With a door-to-door service, we are committed to taking you thoroughly from Hanoi to Cao Bang, also with an airport pickup. You will no longer worry about any issues on the trip, but relax comfortably in our spacious and modern car.

Hanoi To Cao Bang Distance

Where Is Cao Bang In Vietnam?

Cao Bang, a northern province in Vietnam, is renowned for its stunning natural landscapes, including the majestic Ban Gioc Waterfall and the tranquil Nguom Ngao Cave. The region is rich in cultural heritage, with several ethnic minority communities preserving their unique traditions and lifestyles.

Distance From Hanoi To Cao Bang

From the capital Hanoi, tourists have to travel quite a long way to reach Cao Bang. The distance from Hanoi to Cao Bang is approximately 281 km (~174 miles), taking around 6 hours for a one-way trip by car. And if you choose to depart from Hanoi Airport (HAN), it will also take the same amount of time. However, for the trip with stopovers or traffic jams, the travel time will be extended.

How To Get From Hanoi To Cao Bang?

Travelers on this route also have many options for vehicles. Many often choose to take the bus to save on travel costs, but this choice is quite inconvenient for a long journey. Therefore, we highly recommend you use our private car service. Then, you will enjoy a wholesome door-to-door trip with comfort and flexibility throughout the ride.

HANOI TO CAO BANG BY PRIVATE CAR

How To Book A Car?

Quickly book the Hanoi Private Cars for your upcoming trip from Hanoi to Cao Bang by following one of these simple ways:

  • Fill in the available booking form
  • Hotline: (+84) 98.339.3588
  • (Zalo/WhatsApp/Wechat): (+84) 98.339.3488

We are always ready to receive your booking at any time. If you have any questions, our 24/7 customer care is always ready to support you.

Hanoi Airport To Cao Bang Car Transfer

Following your flight number/ landing time, our driver will be ready at the Hanoi Airport arrival gate (Column No.10) with your full name on the welcome board.

Our driver will wait for you until you come out of the Noi Bai Airport arrival gate. In case you can not find our driver or get a flight delay/ flight change, please feel free to contact our 24/7 customer support via Hotline: (+84) 98.339.3588.

After helping you with the luggage, we show you the car, and we’ll start the transfer from Hanoi Airport to Cao Bang by car. Along the way, our experienced driver will be happy to stop at convenient spots for you to take a short break, drink some coffee, and go to the toilets.

Upon arrival at Cao Bang, our driver will drop you off at your hotel/ homestay lobby, and we will finish the private car from Ha Noi to Cao Bang. Vietlook Travel wishes you a great holiday in Cao Bang.

Hanoi To Cao Bang By Private Car

By booking our Hanoi Hotel to Cao Bang by car, please provide us with some information such as the number of people/ luggage, your hotel names in Ha Noi and Cao Bang, and your travel date and pickup time.

Based on this information, our travel agent will send a proper private car and driver to pick you up. Before leaving your hotel in Hanoi, our driver will ensure you get all your passports and belongings.

By booking our Hanoi to Cao Bang by car, you can request a direct transfer, which takes about 6 hours, or some rest stops along the way for toilets, short breaks, coffee, and lunch.

Upon arrival at your hotel/ homestay in Cao Bang, our driver will help you get the luggage, spending 2 minutes to make sure you don’t forget anything in the car. After all, he will say goodbye to you here, and your private car trip from Hanoi to Cao Bang ends here.

Return Trip: Cao Bang To Hanoi By Car

In addition to the private transfer from Hanoi City to Cao Bang, we also provide tourists with the return trip from Cao Bang to Hanoi. It is free for you to choose the drop-off location, whether the Hanoi hotel or the Hanoi Airport. Our driver will come to pick you up at your hotel/ homestay in Cao Bang, and the car trip starts here.

It will also take you about 5,5 – 6 hours to reach Hanoi. Our driver will drop you off at your exact planned location here. Upon arriving, he will helpfully get you out of the car, then take your luggage down. Once everything is done, your return trip from Cao Bang to Hanoi private car also ends.

Vietlook Travel wishes you a great time in the Northern Highland.

Why Should You Choose Us?

  • This is a door-to-door private car with experienced drivers.
  • We own a wide range of cars from sedans, SUVs, Minivans, and Dcar Limousines.
  • All of our cars are new, in good condition, and comfortable with strong A/C.
  • Our travel experts provide 24/7 online support via WhatsApp and email.
  • We offer our valued customers a reasonable and friendly price.
  • You can choose your own convenient departure time and the car type.
  • All private car prices are clearly listed, with no hidden fees.

Useful Travel Tips

  • Please provide us with your flight number and landing time in advance if you choose the airport pickup.
  • For tourists who want to add extra stops along the way, let our travel expert know during the booking process.
  • It is recommended to depart early in the morning (7:00 – 8:00 AM) for a better transfer and sightseeing.
  • But if you want to save your travel time, we also offer a night transfer from Hanoi to Cao Bang.
  • If you meet any problems during the trip, please contact us via (Zalo/WhatsApp/Wechat): (+84) 98.339.3488 for more support.
